capabilities: assign a person to a place for a date range
query and filter booking data via Datacore
view reservations on a Full Calendar view
extras: README lists only two commands (Add Person, Add Booking) and gives no examples of the underlying notes or data format; all actions run through the command palette.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and view guest reservations by person, place, and date range.

relations.evidence: Datacore – Query and filter booking data
Full Calendar – Visual calendar view of reservations

summary: Booking manager that assigns people to places for specific date ranges, storing reservations as queryable data with a calendar view.
